collection_note: Feedback and feedback_at were extracted from local session user turns. Before/after excerpts were reconstructed from the visible discussion and edits; they are selected evidence, not a complete chronological patch replay. Some final text was edited by the reviewer directly.
acceptance_note: Only records with explicit acceptance evidence identify accepted wording. Other revisions remain applied without inferred acceptance. No whole-draft approval is recorded.
style_guide_note: The guide path required by AGENTS.md was unavailable in this environment; no claim of style-guide validation is made.

elapsed_time.interpretation: Wall-clock elapsed review window, including discussion and reader review; not measured active editing time. The agent edited a local worktree of the PR branch; no remote publication by the agent is implied.
